cohort: The study participants were pregnant women with singleton pregnancies, identified as either having uterine rupture (UR group) or not (non-UR group), from 11 hospitals in Jiangsu province, China, matched for age, body mass index, blood pressure, and adequacy of prenatal care.
finding: Multiple uterine surgeries were identified as an independent risk factor for uterine rupture.
mod_finding: Univariate analysis revealed a significantly higher incidence of cesarean section history among uterine rupture patients.
